winnerTruncation.question: Does the retention ladder truncate winners prematurely? How much MFE capture and net expectancy shift with tighter/looser locks and with no ladder at all?

arms.armDetail: lock arm moved beyond the 1.6R target (never arms), rescue equally unreachable, drawdown guard off, time stop effectively off — winners ride to the hard target, losers to the hard stop

winnerTruncation.discipline: Experimental arms; frozen preset never modified; results inform understanding only — no arm is promoted.

turnover.question: How do trade counts (turnover), net expectancy and cost drag respond to the entry gate and the abstention floor? Is current turnover excessive relative to its edge?
turnover.discipline: Experimental arms; frozen policy never modified; results inform understanding only — no arm is promoted.

costDrag.question: How much of the net expectancy is consumed by transaction costs, and how does net scale as costs double?
costDrag.discipline: Experimental arms on the frozen policy; costs are always charged in every arm; no arm is promoted and costs are never waived in any evaluation.

seedDiscipline: null=9xxxxxx (harness base); matrix=41xxxxx; walk-forward=45xxxxx; ablations=43xxxxx; final held-out evaluation family 47xxxxx is untouched by this campaign (no optimization against the held-out dataset; ablation arms are experimental and the frozen pre-registered challenger preset/policy is never modified).
constraintSemantics: All markets synthetic; broker-calibrated costs always charged; champion side is the simplified S1 mirror (SIMPLIFIED_S1_MIRROR), not the deployed V1 Champion; the only actual-V1 datum is the broker-confirmed evidence window (E-7). Negative results are reported exactly as positive ones; no profitability claim is made or implied.
